name: Quilt
description: Split the grid into patches: each holds one number, its size, in the shape shown.
hint: Drag corner to corner to lay a patch · click a patch to remove it · ⌘Z undo

howTo.goal: Split the whole grid into rectangles, called patches.
rules: Each patch holds exactly one number, and covers that many cells.
Its mark gives the shape: a square, tall (taller than wide), wide, or ◇ for any shape.
Every cell belongs to a patch, and every puzzle has exactly one answer.
controls: Lay a patch, corner to corner
